ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and lower regions of both lobes consist of high-intensity white contiguous zones; dense black pigmentation is concentrated along the leading edges and the median notch; a distinct vertical dark linear mark is present at roughly 70% width on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees, though the vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; multiple distinct peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave upward curvature originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark focal pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered across the white fields of both lobes, particularly dense near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical linear disruption on the right lobe; several smaller, low-contrast horizontal scratches visible on the black-pigmented regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear scar on the inner right lobe; irregular jaggedness on the trailing edge suggestive of accumulated minor tissue trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular 'salt-and-pepper' mottling at the interface between the black leading-edge boundary and the white central fields.
